About Us

About

Amro LLC is known for its quality landscaping that our clients in Des Moines and Surrounding Areas appreciate and trust. From small, neighborhood lawns and gardens to sprawling lawns and commercial spaces, we approach every project with care and meticulous detail. We believe in building lasting relationships with our clients, getting to know them and their personal style so that we can best bring their vision to life.

Services

No project is too big or too small for the team at Amro LLC  
Lawncare/Landscaping Services
Residential and Commercial. Our professionals bring their expertise into every service we provide, so we can guarantee you the highest quality and best results. We know you’ll love what we do.

Lawn Care

Our custom Lawn Care services provide solutions for a variety of outdoor spaces. We cater to the needs and requirements of each and every client, guaranteeing you’ll get exactly what you want.

Landscaping 

Keep your property in tip-top shape with our Retaining Walls, Borders, Flower Beds services. Our team does it all, and is ready to provide complete attention to your every need. You can count on us to make sure you’re satisfied with the results.

Fall and Spring Cleaning

Our team will make sure your lawn stays in great condition all year long.  Weed solutions, Leaf cleaning, Branches, Trimming , Flower beds and new plants.  Guaranteeing you’ll get exactly what you want.
